description: M4 Phase 3b scenario (epic #163; objects beyond the house): the boat and the river. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first thirty-one commands are mirror-bat's (troll-combat's sixteen, the round room's RANDOM exits to the Grail Room, the crawlway, Mirror Room 2 and `rub mirror`, which leaves the hero in Mirror Room 1). Then `east` to the Cave, `down` to the Atlantis Room, `se` to Reservoir North, `take pump`, back `north`, `up`, `north` to Mirror Room 1, `west`, `west` to the Slide Room, `down` the slide to the cellar, `east`, `north`, `north`, `down` to Reservoir South, `up`, `east` to the Dam, `down` to the Dam Base; `inflate boat with pump` (IBOAT-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:285: the folded boat replaced by the magic boat), `board boat` (AVEHICLE), `launch` onto the River Frigid, `land` back at the Dam Base, `disembark`, `look`, `deflate boat` (RBOAT-FUNCTION), `take boat`, `inventory`, `score`. The dam's own puzzle is not on this route: this runtime stops on entering the Maintenance Room (PRSOBJ frontier, docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md). Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/BOAT-RIVER-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
